title: Developer
description: Install builds on a simulator or phone; convert SVG, JSON and CSV for code; copy files for an LLM, diff, permalinks and checksums.

actions.label: iOS Sim
actions.description: Install on the booted iOS Simulator and launch it
actions.command: xcrun simctl install booted "$INPUT" && b=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleIdentifier' "$INPUT/Info.plist") && xcrun simctl launch booted "$b" >/dev/null

actions.label: Android
actions.description: Install on the connected device or emulator

actions.label: TSX
actions.description: SVG to a React TSX component (needs network on first run)

actions.label: TS types
actions.description: TypeScript types from JSON (needs network on first run)

actions.label: App icon
actions.description: Make a macOS .icns icon set from a PNG
actions.command: d=$(mktemp -d)/$NAME.iconset; mkdir -p "$d"; for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s "$INPUT" --out "$d/icon_${s}x${s}.png" >/dev/null; sips -z $((s*2)) $((s*2)) "$INPUT" --out "$d/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png" >/dev/null; done; iconutil -c icns "$d" -o "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.icns")"

actions.label: For LLM
actions.description: Copy the file, or a folder tree, as a fenced block with its path for a chat
actions.command:
if [ -d "$INPUT" ]; then { printf '%s
' "Folder: $INPUT" '```'; (cd "$INPUT" && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -name .DS_Store -not -name . | sort); printf '%s
' '```'; } | pbcopy; else [[ $(file -b --mime-encoding "$INPUT") != binary ]] || { echo 'Binary file: nothing to paste' >&2; exit 1; }; { printf '%s
' "File: $INPUT" "\`\`\`${INPUT:e}"; head -c 200000 "$INPUT"; printf '
%s
' '```'; } | pbcopy; fi

actions.label: Minify
actions.description: Strip whitespace from JSON into name.min.json

actions.label: Permalink
actions.description: Copy a GitHub link to this file at the current commit (push it first)
actions.command: d="${INPUT:A}"; [ -d "$d" ] || d="${d:h}"; root=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'Not inside a git repository' >&2; exit 1; }; sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD); url=$(git -C "$root" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#^git@([^:]+):#https://\1/#; s#^ssh://git@([^/]+)/#https://\1/#; s#\.git$##'); [[ -n $url ]] || { echo 'No origin remote' >&2; exit 1; }; p="${INPUT:A}"; rel="${p#$root}"; rel="${rel#/}"; if [ -d "$p" ]; then kind=tree; else kind=blob; fi; printf '%s/%s/%s/%s' "$url" "$kind" "$sha" "$rel" | pbcopy

actions.label: Diff files
actions.description: Compare two files in VS Code (or FileMerge)
actions.command: files=("${(@f)INPUTS}"); c="/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/code"; if [[ -x $c ]]; then "$c" --diff "${files[1]}" "${files[2]}"; elif command -v opendiff >/dev/null; then opendiff "${files[1]}" "${files[2]}"; else echo 'Install VS Code or Xcode to diff files' >&2; exit 1; fi

actions.label: Verify
actions.description: Check the file against a SHA-256 you copied
actions.command: a=$(shasum -a 256 "$INPUT" | cut -d' ' -f1); b=$(pbpaste | tr -d '[:space:]' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f'); [[ ${#b} -eq 64 ]] || { echo 'Copy a SHA-256 (64 hex characters) first' >&2; exit 1; }; [[ $a == $b ]] || { echo "SHA-256 does NOT match. File: $a Clipboard: $b" >&2; exit 1; }
